subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Allies and Companions
description: Learn Allies and Companions in one minute.

hook.text: Gilgamesh had Enkidu. Frodo had Sam. Odysseus had his crew. No hero conquers alone.

buildup.text: Allies provide what the hero lacks: strength, wisdom, humor, or loyalty when courage falters.

discovery.text: Each companion represents a part of the hero's psyche. Sam is Frodo's hope. Enkidu is Gilgamesh's heart.

twist.text: Allies can betray. Judas, Loki, and Brutus all walked beside the hero before turning.

climax.text: The deepest bonds in myth form under pressure. Shared suffering creates loyalty no oath can match.

punchline.text: The companion makes the hero human.
